title: Prove the exact rank of additive Boolean disjointness repair
body:
This proves an exact rank formula for an F2 additive repair of the disjointness endpoint reported in [PR #172](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/172). It gives a scoped obstruction to repairing that disjointness endpoint with a small number of copied scalar centres. **No complete kappa improvement or new supplier is claimed.**

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/378275c8e1228d7cdad4888d808a8b8c6395b32e/research/boolean-disjointness-repair/PROOF.txt), [exact rank receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/378275c8e1228d7cdad4888d808a8b8c6395b32e/research/boolean-disjointness-repair/ZETA-CORRECTOR-CHECK.json), [independent agent review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/378275c8e1228d7cdad4888d808a8b8c6395b32e/research/boolean-disjointness-repair/review/REVIEW.md), and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/378275c8e1228d7cdad4888d808a8b8c6395b32e/research/boolean-disjointness-repair/SOURCES.json).

For every integer `h>=2`, let `A_h` be the disjointness matrix on the nonempty proper subsets of `[h]`, over F2. Then

```text
rank_F2(I+A_h) = (2^(h+1) - 2*(-1)^h - 3)/3.
```

An additive repair to the identity by `ell` rank-one F2 terms therefore needs at least this many terms. Under the assumed ledger `D=2v-3ell`, with `v=2^h-2`, this gives `D<=1` for even h and `D<=-3` for odd h. The proof resolves this specified repair route; it does not rule out a different source basis, endpoint, nonadditive operation, or compiler. It does not assert that every physical correction has this additive form.

From the repository root, with Python 3.10+ and its standard library:

```sh
python3 -B research/boolean-disjointness-repair/verify.py
```

Expected final line:

```text
PASS_BOOLEAN_DISJOINTNESS_REPAIR h=2..11 independent_kernels=2..4 no_new_kappa
```

Fresh replay passed exact binary elimination for h=2..11 and complete kernel enumeration for h=2,3,4. The separate review checked an alternate deletion proof, reconstructed set-based matrices for h=2..7, and rejected five altered proofs, formulas, kernel/parity conditions, or receipts. The wrapper and controls also passed with `PYTHONOPTIMIZE=1`. Finite checks support the written all-h proof; they are not its substitute. No Lean, complete supplier replay, repository-wide build, or hosted CI pass is claimed.

The base is `cef4b52f2a59009865bf8eabde1be3f159063703`. The consumed PR172 head is `427b23bc79489e7b2b7548bfd434dd9670fd5c47`; its [README](https://github.com/mikey1201/integer-mult-bounds/blob/427b23bc79489e7b2b7548bfd434dd9670fd5c47/research/zeta-family/README.md) supplies the endpoint and ledger. Its [NOTICE](https://github.com/mikey1201/integer-mult-bounds/blob/427b23bc79489e7b2b7548bfd434dd9670fd5c47/research/zeta-family/NOTICE) credits @icekylinx for the [PR #144](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/144) compiler and bookkeeping lineage and records Cline assistance. No predecessor implementation is imported.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate agent proof review. This is not independent human review. New work is Apache-2.0. The package records the remaining changed-model question and its first required step: an exact physical identity with a complete cost account.
